title: Seize an Icon without legendary planets
description: Alpha report fb_1792227611_a263a756: a player held Seize an Icon (control a legendary planet) on a map with none. By the rules the card stays in the deck and can be dealt, and the project's setup rule keeps it because Mallice (Wormhole Nexus) or Mirage could still arrive. The held card now says so instead of sitting at 0 / 1 unexplained. Mocked fixtures; regenerate with npm run screenshots -- EZ.

notes.title: Why the card was dealt
notes.text: Dealing follows the rules (secrets stay in the deck). The project's setup rule (map_feasibility) removes only cards that even a perfect game cannot score; Seize an Icon is kept whenever the census finds any legendary planet, and the locked Mallice tile in the Wormhole Nexus counts. No engine change.

notes.title: When the note shows
notes.text: Only for Seize an Icon, only when the board lists its tiles and none of the main-map planets is legendary. Nexus and Fracture tiles count once they hold something.
